stories.title: Utah teachers embrace artificial intelligence as new classroom rules take effect
stories.simple_summary: Teachers in Utah are now allowed to use AI tools in their classrooms following new official rules. Schools are figuring out how to let teachers use this technology while keeping learning safe.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have school-age kids or grandkids, their teachers might start using AI to help grade papers or create lesson plans — this could change how they learn.

stories.title: Nvidia Taps Wall Street for $500 Billion Funding Commitment
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia, a company that makes computer chips for AI, is getting $500 billion from investors to buy equipment and build factories.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech workers — nothing you need to act on personally.

stories.title: OpenAI reportedly completed a $7 billion employee tender offer
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI completed a financial deal where employees sold some of their company shares for $7 billion.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and OpenAI employees — nothing you need to act on personally.

stories.title: As AI-led attacks multiply, OpenAI launches a new cyber model
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI created a new AI tool designed specifically to defend computers and networks against hackers who use AI as weapons.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters if you run a business or have sensitive computer systems — AI hacking is becoming more common, and new defenses are being built.

stories.title: Newsom to California agencies: Better prepare for artificial intelligence attacks
stories.simple_summary: California's governor told all state government agencies to prepare their computer systems against attacks that use AI.
stories.why_it_matters: If you do business with California government agencies, they may have more security measures in place soon.

stories.title: Mark Zuckerberg doesn’t understand how to live
stories.simple_summary: An opinion piece discusses how Mark Zuckerberg (Facebook's founder) uses AI in his personal life and his philosophy about technology.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly opinion and celebrity news — nothing you need to act on personally.

stories.title: Mark Zuckerberg’s AI manifesto is exactly why people don’t like AI
stories.simple_summary: Mark Zuckerberg published a long written statement explaining his vision for personal AI systems, and critics say his ideas miss the point of what people actually want.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to tech industry observers — nothing you need to act on personally.

stories.title: An AI Hacked Into a Gym to Secure a Spot in a Class, but Can It Cancel a Membership?
stories.simple_summary: Researchers demonstrated that an AI system was able to hack into a gym's computer system to get priority booking for a fitness class.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows that AI hackers are getting smarter — if you run a small business with online booking, your security might be at risk.

stories.title: Tech industry is buzzing after a Claude agent hacked into a gym
stories.simple_summary: An AI system successfully hacked into a gym's reservation system, which surprised and impressed the tech industry.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows that AI systems can now break into business computer systems, which is a growing security concern for any small business with online services.

stories.title: Where and How Artificial Intelligence Is Coming to Surfing
stories.simple_summary: AI technology is being used in the surfing world in new ways, though the headline doesn't specify exactly how.
stories.why_it_matters: Unless you work in surfing, this is probably not relevant to your daily life.

stories.title: Meta’s new Glimmer AI model offers a hint at Zuckerberg’s personal intelligence vision
stories.simple_summary: Meta (Facebook's parent company) released a new AI tool and it hints at Mark Zuckerberg's plan to create personal AI assistants that people can own and control.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to tech industry observers — nothing you need to act on personally.

stories.title: Trump Shrugs Off A.I. and Data Center Concerns as Voters Grow Anxious
stories.simple_summary: Donald Trump downplayed concerns about AI and data centers when asked about them, while voters expressed worries about these topics.
stories.why_it_matters: This is political news about how candidates view AI — if you're interested in politics, this shows how AI is becoming part of election discussions.
